name: mc_light
title: Light and spawn check
description:
Finds dark spaces in a box where hostile mobs can spawn, and can suggest light positions so none are left. Read-only.

WHEN TO USE: after building an interior, cave, basement, wall walk or courtyard: "can mobs spawn here?", plus a list of light positions ready for mc_build `cells`. Re-run after placing them to confirm 0 dark spaces.
WHEN NOT TO USE: for appearance (mc_render) or walking (mc_walk). Mob-specific rules (biomes, slime chunks, structures, spawners, mob size) are not modelled.

PARAMETERS: from/to inclusive corners, at most limits.max-read-volume. A spawn space has open feet and head cells (air, plants, 1-layer snow; not carpet, water, rails, buttons, plates or redstone) over a floor with a full solid top (top/double slabs and upside-down stairs count; glass, leaves, ice, magma, bottom slabs, upright stairs, fences and walls do not). Sky light is ignored (night) unless includeSky. suggest.placement: "hidden" (default for the light block: inside the dark spaces; light blocks have no collision), "floor", or "ceiling" (the open cell under a ceiling up to 16 blocks above). suggest.level: for the light block it sets the level; for other blocks give the level they emit.

SIDE EFFECTS: read-only; chunks are copied a few per tick and analysed off the main thread. Dark spaces use the server's own light, so lamps outside the box count; the coverage of suggested lights is estimated inside the box only, and the server updates light a moment after blocks change: wait a few seconds before re-checking.

world.description: World name; default: the configured default world.

threshold.description: A space is dark when its light is at most this (0-14). Default 0.

includeSky.description: Also require sky light <= threshold (dark even by day). Default false: sky light ignored.

spawnable.description: true (default): only spaces a mob can spawn in; false: every open cell.

suggest.description: Ask for a greedy list of light positions in mc_build cells form.

level.description: Light level the block emits. Default 11.

spacing.description: Minimum distance between lights (largest axis difference). Default 1.

placement.description: hidden (light block only, default), floor or ceiling.
